description: This file is a shell script for testing Git diff options, specifically focusing on the pickaxe feature and regex matching in diffs. It contains setup steps, test case definitions, and assertions for verifying Git behavior regarding file modifications.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Sets up a test commit with initial files.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock to ensure unique commit timestamps.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
